mapper.select: SELECT id, task_type, project_id, status, progress, current_step, error_message, token_usage, created_at, updated_at FROM story_generation_task WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, task_type, project_id, status, progress, current_step, error_message, token_usage, created_at, updated_at FROM story_generation_task ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO story_generation_task (task_type, project_id, status, progress, current_step, error_message, token_usage, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{taskType}, #{projectId}, #{status}, #{progress}, #{currentStep}, #{errorMessage}, #{tokenUsage}::jsonb, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE story_generation_task SET status = #{status}, progress = #{progress}, current_step = #{currentStep}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, token_usage = #{tokenUsage}::jsonb, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
